body.purpose: One cell grid; font family and size controlled by the terminal.

emphasis.purpose: ANSI emphasis for navigation, headings and measurements.

motion.name: sync-progress-frame
motion.purpose: Real sync activity only; pending dots and ASCII spinner.

components.name: Numbered navigation
components.description: Six views; active item uses sky blue inverse fill, bold and brackets. Light counterpart: active-tab-light. One-cell horizontal padding; 1–6 or Tab / Shift+Tab.

components.name: Scope controls
components.description: Sky blue bold keys and neutral labels with three-cell gaps; muted active-filter row beneath.

components.name: Token readout strip
components.description: Transparent four-row strip with equal blank insets above and below; six filtered-result measurements, labels above values. Total uses pink. Light counterpart: readout-light. Context replaces sums with explanatory text.

components.name: Focused table row
components.description: Selected fill with leading >; right-aligned numbers and left-aligned dimensions. Light counterpart: selected-row-light. Arrow keys and j/k move focus; horizontal scrolling exposes columns.

components.name: Scope drawer
components.description: Transparent right overlay starts at row index 2, maximum 44 cells wide, one-cell vertical divider and two-cell inset. Light counterpart: drawer-light. > marks focus; * current single choice; [ ]/[x] multiselect. Enter Apply; Escape Cancel.

components.name: Coverage and shortcuts
components.description: Four footer rows reserve spacer, session coverage, rule and shortcuts. Row/horizontal position remains visible; hints compact to Filters, Help and Quit when needed.

components.name: Recovery state
components.description: In-table loading, empty and query-failure text preserve the canvas. Empty scope offers date/filter recovery; errors offer Retry; no synced sessions offers a sync command.

narrative.overview:
A precision measurement desk for local usky blue. Quiet canvas, clear readouts and a
broad table make comparisons immediate. Sky blue marks interaction; pink marks
totals. The terminal owns font choice, font size and cell geometry.

This contract covers the Go terminal renderer under `internal/cli/`. The
repository-root `DESIGN.md` governs the separate browser interface. Tokens here
describe terminal cells, rows and ANSI emphasis, not browser CSS dimensions.
The light and dark palettes follow terminal theme detection.
keyCharacteristics: Full-screen measurement surface with restrained rules.
Spacious readouts above a dense, aligned table.
Explicit keyboard focus and persistent scope and coverage.

rules.name: The Redundant Focus Rule
rules.body: Pair selection color with text markers: brackets around the active tab, `>` on the focused row, and explicit drawer selection marks.

rules.name: The Terminal Type Rule
rules.body: Preserve the user's cell grid and font settings; establish hierarchy through emphasis and alignment.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Use whitespace and sparse rules to separate surfaces; keep the table free of decorative containers.

dos: **Do** preserve the terminal background and use adaptive foreground colors.
**Do** preserve text markers alongside semantic color.
**Do** keep filtered readouts, visible rows and session coverage distinct.
**Do** retain keyboard access and scrolling when space contracts.
**Do** show recovery actions within empty and failed states.
donts: **Don't** sum Session Peak Context Load into a total.
**Don't** derive totals from abbreviated cell text or the visible viewport.
**Don't** impose browser type scales, pixel breakpoints or font choices.
**Don't** add decorative shadows, rounded cards or animation to this flat desk.
